I, Munasingha Kariyawasam Appuhamilage Don SomadasaGunawardana, Minister of Lands, hereby declare under Sub-section(1) of Section 5 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the land describedbelow is needed for a public purpose and will be acquired under theprovisions of that Act.

Boundaries to the land containing in extent of 2.7972 Hectaresdepicted in the Advance Tracing No.: MR/MTR/2014/475 of16.10.2014 prepared by the Surveyor - General, and located in theVillage of Rassandeniya, Wellamadama in Matara Four Gravets MinorDivision in Matara Divisional Secretay's Division, Matara District,Southern Province.
